explanation: Casablanca is the business hub and Marrakesh, whose name gave us the word Morocco, draws the tourists, but parliament and the royal palace are in Rabat.

claims.text: Rabat is the capital of Morocco.
Casablanca, Marrakesh and Fez are Moroccan cities, but none of them is the capital.
Casablanca is Morocco's main business centre, and Marrakesh is a major destination for tourists.
The English name Morocco comes from the name of the city of Marrakesh.
Morocco's parliament and main royal palace are in Rabat.
